target_customer: Software teams and open source maintainers who wanted faster pull request review
problem: Pull requests wait on human reviewers; many are low risk and would be approved anyway.
business_model: SaaS subscription (pricing page existed, details not found)

founders.name: Kiril Videlov
previous_startups: Sturdy (YC W21, Codeball was built there)
founders.background_notes: YC page: software enthusiast who loves developer tools.

founders.name: Gustav Westling
founders.background_notes: Posted the YC launch; based in Stockholm.

exit.reason: Not stated by the company; third party sources say the product was discontinued or closed.

technical_complexity.rationale: Training a model on over a million pull requests to predict reviewer approval and shipping it as a GitHub Action was research adjacent for a three person team.

defensibility.rationale: Training data came from public repositories that anyone could use, and code models improved fast for everyone.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Later AI review tools (Graphite, CodeRabbit and others) took the market; Codeball went dormant, with the repo last pushed April 2023 per an index.

market_need_then: Review latency is a common developer complaint and the product reported use in over 100 open source repositories at launch.

branding.domain_note: Used codeball.ai per a review page; no purchase history found.
branding.community_and_virality: Reached the Hacker News front page per the YC launch post and was launched on Product Hunt on 2022-06-14.

brand_strength.rationale: A memorable product name with a Hacker News front page moment, but little other brand evidence.

outcome_analysis: Codeball was an AI pull request approver built by the Sturdy team in Stockholm, which raised a reported 1.5 million dollar seed round in 2021. The product appears abandoned: the domain no longer represents it and the open source action was last pushed in April 2023. No founder post-mortem was found, so the cause is not public and failure factors are left empty.
notes: The funding rests on aggregators for Sturdy, the parent: VCBacked says July 2021, Seedtable says April 2021 with Y Combinator pre-seed; CB Insights credits Codeball itself with 500K (single database, not recorded as a round). Company website not fetched (no URL on YC page); codeball.ai reported dead by a review site. YC launch post names no competitors; search results for rivals were dated 2024 or later, so the list is empty. Sturdy is a separate YC W21 entry.
